blocks.x: What about banjo players and guitar players?

Banjo players and guitar players? Well it was John Marrera, Caffrey D'Aaron's Boyd, and Son Thomas, and Henry Kimmel. And Cells. They were terrific. And Caffrey D'Aaron's Boyd was one of them. John Marrera basically played, you know, the beat. Real great. John Marrera was a, I should say, name. Boyd played with Sam Marrera was a really good banjo player.
John E. J., was that the other one?
No, no, it was another one. He was after John E. J., I think between him and George Gennon. John E. J. J. J. I'll find a guy. He was terrific. Terrific.
What kind of a beat did they feature? Did they feature a straight four or two?

Straight four, like, somewhat like Lawrence Marrera player, but it wasn't a tied four like we played, you know. It was a spirit of a beat, you know. A post-vote vote. Diff-vote vote. Diff-vote vote.
